choices.content: Its endpoint is \(B\), and it extends infinitely in the direction from \(B\) to \(A\)
Its endpoint is \(A\), and it extends infinitely in the direction from \(A\) to \(B\)
It can extend infinitely in both directions

question.prompt: Which of the following statements about ray \(AB\) is correct?

solutions.explanation: Ray \(AB\) has endpoint \(A\), passes through point \(B\), and extends infinitely in the direction from \(A\) to \(B\). The letter naming the endpoint is written first.
solutions.title: Read the ray notation
